register.heading: Sign up for Streaming Platform
register.backButtonLabel: Already have an account? Log in
register.usernameDescription: This is the name other users will know you by.
register.emailDescription: We may use your email to send you messages about your account.
register.passwordDescription: Your password must be at least 8 characters long.
register.successAlertDescription: We've sent a confirmation email to your address. If you don't see it, check your spam folder.

login.heading: Log in to Streaming Platform
login.backButtonLabel: Don't have an account? Sign up!
login.loginDescription: The username or email you signed up with.
login.passwordDescription: The password you signed up with.
login.pinDescription: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

resetPassword.heading: Reset password
resetPassword.backButtonLabel: Already have an account? Log in
resetPassword.emailDescription: The email you signed up with.
resetPassword.successAlertDescription: We've sent a password reset link to your email. If you have Telegram notifications turned on, we've sent the link there too.

newPassword.heading: New password
newPassword.backButtonLabel: Already have an account? Log in
newPassword.passwordDescription: Your new password must be at least 8 characters long.
newPassword.passwordRepeatDescription: Repeat your new password to confirm it.
